title: An outstanding private...
text: An outstanding private bike tour in Barcelona! Our guide - Pau - was fantastic. Knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive. The route was thoughtfully planned, showcasing hidden gems and iconic sights. Top-level service throughout, and the bikes were high quality and comfortable. Highly recommended!
author: vthy7rcc54

title: Highly recommend
text: The company was extremely responsive. Knowledgable guide. Clean and new equipment. Would definitely use them again.
author: Shawn_C

title: Excellent bike ride...
text: Excellent bike ride in the heart of Barcelona. The best way to get an overview of this magnificent city. Very easy with electric bikes. A very big thank you to our guide who captivated us with his explanations!!! Highly recommended without hesitation!!!
author: Nathalie_B

title: The discovery of place by bike
text:
The guide gave us a lot of explanation. It c is adapted to our level. My daughter who was afraid of electric bike was able to visit with a classic bike.
A very nice discovery of Barcelona by bike that requires little effort.
Beautiful places.
author: Laurence_M

title: Biking introduction to Barcelona
text:
If you want a broad overview of Barcelona including history, and a current contemporary context in an active way, this tour is for you . Pau was an excellent guide and we
Learned so much ! Loved it all!
author: Cathy_F

title: 3 hours in couple with our guide Janis!
text:
Janis has managed to get off the traditional path without forgetting the key stages of this beautiful city.
Janis is adapted to our desires, our rhythm, relevant explanations, and all in a very good French 🙏
We highly recommend this experience, especially if they are based 1min from the Sagrada Familia.
author: Franck_B

title: An exceptional tour
text: A beautiful afternoon cycling between the barygothic, the beach and modernist Barcelona, the guide who accompanied us is very kind and extremely competent. Communication via wapp is very simple and they respond quickly, are particularly helpful, super positive experience!
author: angelagQ8208YN

title: Thanks to Janis for...
text:
Thanks to Janis for this wonderful discovery of Barcelona, from Gaudi to the Olympic Games by the sea, passing through the beautiful citadel park and the little streets of the Gothic quarter.
We strongly recommend this bike tour.
Friendly 
Didier and Annik
author: Didier_R

title: Fabulous - highly recommended!
text: Our tour guide, Janice, was fantastic.  We travelled with another  couple & there were only the 4 of us in the group.  Janice took us on a personalized tour & we saw all the highlights of Barcelona.  Her knowledge of history is great & she shared many interesting facts with us.  We would highly recommend this tour!!!
author: Maureen C

title: Awesome tour and guide
text: Janice was a great guide. She showed us all around her beautiful city of Barcelona. E-bikes were great and the city is fascinating. Highly recommend!
